facts.text: American Flag was deployed at Descartes Highlands during Apollo 16 in 1972.
Planted during EVA-1. The famous photo of Young saluting the flag while jumping off the ground was taken by Duke — Young's feet are clearly off the surface in lunar gravity.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.

The jumping salute photograph became an iconic demonstration of lunar gravity — Young's body position and height off the ground helped scientists calculate the reduced gravitational acceleration at the surface.
LROC images from 2012 confirm the Apollo 16 flag is still standing, casting a shadow on the highland surface.
